# MailKit SMTP Generated Solution

This temporary Generated Solution is the acceptance seam for issue 31. It
selects PostgreSQL and the app-owned MailKit SMTP notification adapter, records
durable notification intent before external delivery, and keeps the provider
claim-free until executable evidence promotes it.

The fixture uses Mailpit 1.30.0 for SMTP integration evidence. It never sends
Development messages to real recipients and it contains no secret values.
